description: This file contains functions for managing and enforcing secrets in provider configurations, including resolving API keys and headers from secret references, and normalizing provider lookup.

methods.name: normalizeSourceProviderLookup
methods.description: Normalizes provider lookup by trimming keys and filtering invalid entries.

methods.name: resolveSourceManagedApiKeyMarker
methods.description: Resolves the API key marker for a source provider, considering environment and non-environment secret references.

methods.name: resolveSourceManagedHeaderMarkers
methods.description: Resolves header markers for a source provider, converting secret references into marker strings.
